title: Imaging Site-of-Service Points on Non-Covered Discounts — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Where an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account carries CT or MRI imaging, the campus that rendered the services changes the non-covered discount percent.

**Clause.** An account with at least one CT charge line (revenue code 0350) or MRI charge line (revenue code 0610) posted on it whose facility is Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute adds 5 percentage points to the non-covered discount percent; such an account whose facility is any other Riverbend campus adds 2 percentage points; an account with no CT or MRI charge line adds none.

## Decision table

| Account's facility | CT (0350) or MRI (0610) charge line posted | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute | yes | 5 |
| Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton | yes | 2 |
| Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah | yes | 2 |
| Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton | yes | 2 |
| any campus | no | none |

## Points of judgement

- One CT or MRI charge line is enough; several lines add the same points as one.
- The facility is the campus recorded on the account itself.
- *Case (hypothetical).* An account at the Neenah campus with one MRI line and two laboratory lines adds 2 percentage points; the same account with only the laboratory lines adds none.
